title: Step 66-A Content SEO and Policy Frontend canonical handoff, live discovery and scope freeze
description: MEDIUM-risk documentation/governance-only Step 66-A. Freeze the Content, SEO & Policy Frontend execution boundary from canonical main after terminal Step 65. Record current Storefront placeholders, authoritative public article runtime, incomplete OpenAPI/generated response typing, backend SEO/canonical authority, internal sitemap capability without a public HTTP boundary, absence of public Contact mutation, and missing public archive/stop-sale listing contract. Preserve Step-55 content/policy UX obligations and freeze the staged A-I execution plan without runtime/API/OpenAPI/database/dependency/business-rule mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fresh live guard records canonical main, terminal Step-65 evidence, HOS-70 activation and absence of competing Step-66 writers before mutation.
Stage A records the seven current Step-66 Storefront placeholders SF-F-01 through SF-F-07 and freezes Step-55 F design intent as UX authority only, never as API or business-rule authority.

Public Article runtime authority is recorded exactly: GET /articles, GET /articles/:slug and GET /articles/:slug/related expose published public content, bounded cursor/limit behavior and backend-derived SEO metadata.

OpenAPI currently lacks typed JSON response schemas for all three public Article endpoints; Stage 66-B must reconcile runtime/OpenAPI/generated TypeScript before production Storefront consumes them. Untyped frontend-local article response models are forbidden as a substitute.

SEO/sitemap authority is frozen accurately: ArticleSeoService owns canonical/indexability metadata; ArticleSitemapService owns bounded published-article sitemap data internally; no public sitemap.xml or robots.txt HTTP boundary is currently established.

About, FAQ and policy screens remain static-approved-content intent; Contact has no approved public mutation. Stage 66 must not invent legal terms, support channels, SLAs, partners, certifications, contact-success states or sensitive-data collection.

Archive/stop-sale authority is frozen fail-closed: public Catalog reads expose published products and effective sales_enabled state, while archive/unarchive and stop/resume are staff-only mutations. No public archive/stop-sale collection contract or Storefront route currently exists, so frontend routes/data semantics must not be guessed.

Frozen A-I execution plan places contract/readiness before frontend implementation, separates dynamic article/SEO work from static policy/contact surfaces, defers archive/stop-sale views until public authority exists, and reserves integrated acceptance/final closure stages.
Stage A changes only its three documentation/governance paths; no runtime/API/OpenAPI/database/dependency/business-rule/Product-Design/current-state/workflow mutation is introduced.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI and Phase A, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 66-B mutation.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 66-A is MEDIUM risk and requires no Human Gate. Stage 66-B mutation remains blocked until 66-A protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
